Definition
[Retraction]

\group Homotopy Theory

A retraction of $X$ onto $A\subset X$ is a map $r:X\to X$ with $r(X)=A$ and $r|_A=\one $. Equivalently, $r^2=r$; one may instead regard $r$ as a map $X\to A$ restricting to the identity on $A$.

A deformation retraction is a homotopy rel $A$ from $\one _X$ to a retraction.
